pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The patches consist of large, irregular polygons with sharp, angular edge transitions. The spatial area of patches on the upper neck and dorsal region is significantly larger than the smaller, more fragmented patches observed toward the lower flank and belly.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, high-contrast lattice. Corridors exhibit consistent pixel thickness across the mid-section, with junction nodes primarily displaying tri-radial and quad-radial intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark mane is visible along the dorsal neck, presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile against the background. The fringe remains relatively uniform in height across the visible upper neck segment.
